note: Execution-layer counterpart of data/anchor_map.json. That table anchors the consensus labels to consensus-specs pyspec symbols; this one anchors the value-bearing execution labels used by the EthTotal track to EELS symbols. Which surface a label corresponds to is reviewed judgment (see each row's `why`); whether the symbol EXISTS is not asserted — every row was resolved by locating the definition in the pinned checkout, and the file/line recorded. Regenerate after an execution-specs bump: a symbol that moved or was renamed fails the build rather than silently anchoring to nothing. Anchors are fork-scoped (see spec_fork); a different fork means regenerating, not editing.

state-trie.why: account balance persistence and the state root computed from it — the surface a supply/balance reconciliation invariant lives on

transactions.why: value transfer and sender debit: where an overdraft, a stale read or a self-transfer would create value

gas.why: the prepay -> refund/priority-fee/base-fee-burn settlement; the fee split itself is performed inside process_transaction

evm.why: CALL/CREATE value semantics, executed through the message-processing path

opcodes.why: account lifecycle at the opcode level: SELFDESTRUCT, storage writes and the empty-account predicate

database.why: the journal/commit/rollback path — where a record is made durable, and where an ordering or revert defect corrupts the audit trail

block-processing.why: block-level application of rewards, fees and withdrawals — the mint/burn attribution surface

precompiles.why: the precompile dispatch table; value-forwarding precompile paths enter here

beacon-chain:withdrawal.why: NOTE: the dataset label is the consensus-side name, but the properties it carries here are about the EXECUTION-layer credit of a withdrawal, so the anchored surface is the EL one. Recorded explicitly rather than silently.
